description: Get script to run despite a Content-Security-Policy — the step after finding an injection that CSP is blocking. Load when you have HTML/JS injection but the payload won't execute, on "CSP is blocking my XSS", or when auditing a CSP for weakness. Signals: a Content-Security-Policy header, a blocked-script console error, a reflected injection with no popup.
